summary: A structured collection of Delphi/Object Pascal projects demonstrating advanced programming concepts, including recursion, data structures, mathematical computation, GUI development, and automated testing.
key_features: CRUD-style data management system with I/O
achievements: Developed and optimized complex recursive algorithms for combinatorial problems. Engineered a mathematical expression parser with GUI-based function plotting. Implemented custom typed list data structures and a CRUD system with persistent storage. Integrated DUnitX framework for automated unit testing across multiple modules. Structured a multi-project academic repository with version control, IDE configurations, and detailed technical documentation.
